verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal exposes a robust API for core operations—reader registration (serial/code/order number), locations/zones (docs show dashboard-or-api=api), payments, refunds, and receipt data—supporting a full custom API-driven POS build. However, some capabilities are explicitly framed as Dashboard/no-code-only conveniences (no-code payment acceptance, Dashboard-based reader ordering/monitoring, on-reader tipping UX), and hardware ordering/monitoring appears to route through the Dashboard, so full UI-API parity isn't fully evidenced.
